text:
Raat kitni hi lambi ho,
Subah apna raasta dhoond hi leti hai.
Andhere se darna kya,
Ye toh sirf naye savere ki tayari hai.
Harr tanha pal ke baad,
Ek khubsurat subah tera intezaar kar rahi hai.
title: Nayi Subah
description: Ek umeed bhari kavita jo andhere raaton ke baad aane wali roshni aur hausle ko bayan karti hai.
